prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” AI video ad maker — the right choice depends on what you need (realistic AI presenters vs. animated templates, e‑commerce product variations vs. short social clips, budget, languages, integrations). Below are the top options by use case, with quick pros/cons to help you pick.

Top picks and when to use them
- Synthesia — Best for realistic AI presenters/spokespeople and multilingual voiceovers. Great for landing-page/promo videos and personalized messages. Enterprise pricing; easy to use.
- HeyGen (formerly Movio/Colossyan-like) — Cheaper alternative to Synthesia for AI presenters with many templates and languages. Fast for social ads.
- Movio — Strong for personalized/scaleable spokesperson videos and marketing personalization.
- InVideo / Vimeo Create — Template-driven, cheap, fast for social ad formats (16:9/1:1/9:16). Good for marketers who want quick edits and lots of stock assets.
- Pictory — Best for turning long-form content or scripts into short social ads automatically (good for repurposing webinars/blogs).
- Lumen5 — Good for blog-to-video and quick social ad creation when you want text-focused visuals with minimal editing time.
- Shakr (and Spirable/VidMob workflows) — Designed for e‑commerce & social ad production at scale; supports dynamic product variants and A/B testing workflows.
- Runway — Best if you want advanced generative/creative visuals (AI-driven editing, effects). More experimental and powerful for unique visuals.
- Descript — Best if you need tight editing, overdub voice, captions, and repurposing long clips into ads; excellent for workflow and collaboration.

How to choose quickly
- Want realistic AI actor/presenter: Synthesia or HeyGen.
- Need many platform-specific short ads fast (templates + stock): InVideo, Canva Video, Lumen5.
- Repurposing long content into short ads: Pictory or Descript.
- E‑commerce/product personalization at scale: Shakr, Spirable, or VidMob workflows.
- Cutting-edge generative visuals/unique creative style: Runway or Kaiber.
- Tight budget / DIY: InVideo, Canva, or Lumen5.

If you tell me:
- the platform (TikTok, Facebook, YouTube),
- ad length and style (talking head, animated, product showcase),
- and your budget,

I’ll recommend the single best tool for your needs and a quick workflow to produce your first ad.
